name: Eber
overview: Eber is a male descendant of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Shashak according to 1 Chronicles 8:22. There are no additional notes provided about his life or activities. His mention situates him within the genealogical records of Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Eber means "[regions] beyond [the river]," reflecting a geographic or ancestral significance rather than a divine naming. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 8:22 and was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Eber is the son of Shashak, as stated in 1 Chronicles 8:22. No other family relationships are documented in the provided information.
scriptureSignificance: Eber holds an important place in biblical genealogy as a key link in the lineage from Noah to Abraham, preserving the godly line after the flood. He is recognized as the ancestor from whom the Hebrews derive their name, highlighting his significance in the identity of God's chosen people. His role as the father of Peleg, during whose time the earth was divided, marks a notable period in biblical history.
